nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.xnat_upload¶

CLI: upload qvtpy/eICAB results to XNAT session resources.

Requires a complete qvtpy tree through stage-7 morphometrics before uploading the qvtpy resource (stage2–stage7 by default; stage7 is always enforced).
